mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, the temperature is 56 degrees with clear skies at Fireman Park. Tonight, look for the ISS passing across the sky starting at 7:06 PM; it will rise over Mount Horeb and travel toward Belleville, staying low near the horizon.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month in Verona to honor the hard work of our planning department. Additionally, keep an eye out for potential mail regarding mandatory cross connection control surveys to keep our water supply safe.

It is a busy few days in the area. We have live music at Baileys Run today and at Paddy Macs tomorrow. You can also catch the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, followed by the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival this Saturday.
In our weekly update, on September 21, an individual was identified via surveillance video and cited for retail theft after stealing Swedish Fish candy from a local retailer.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is open today until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
